pli-tv-kd7:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena tiṃsamattā pāveyyakā bhikkhū sabbe āraññakā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sāvatthiṃ gacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upakaṭṭhāya vassūpanāyikāya nāsakkhiṃsu sāvatthiyaṃ vassūpanāyikaṃ sambhāvetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.4: te ukkaṇṭhitarūpā vassaṃ vasiṃsu “āsanneva no bhagavā viharati ito chasu yojanesu. na ca mayaṃ labhāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā temāsaccayena katāya pavāraṇāya deve vassante udakasaṅgahe udakacikkhalle okapuṇṇehi cīvarehi kilantarūpā,
pli-tv-kd7:1.1.6: yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo, yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.1: āciṇṇaṃ kho panetaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.2: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.4: kacci samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā phāsukaṃ vassaṃ vasittha? na ca piṇḍakena kilamitthā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.6: samaggā ca mayaṃ bhante, sammodamānā avivadamānā vassaṃ vasimha. na ca piṇḍakena kilamimha.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.7: idha mayaṃ bhante tiṃsamattā pāveyyakā bhikkhū sāvatthiṃ āgacchantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upakaṭṭhāya vassūpanāyikāya nāsakkhimha sāvatthiyaṃ vassūpanāyikaṃ sambhāvetuṃ. antarāmagge sākete vassaṃ upagacchimha.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.8: te mayaṃ bhante ukkaṇṭhitarūpā vassaṃ vasimha
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.9: ‘āsanneva no bhagavā viharati ito chasu yojanesu. na ca mayaṃ labhāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.2.10: atha kho mayaṃ bhante vassaṃ vutthā, temāsaccayena katāya pavāraṇāya, deve vassante udakasaṅgahe udakacikkhalle okapuṇṇehi cīvarehi kilantarūpā addhānaṃ āgatā”ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.2: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, vassaṃ vutthānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.4: anāmantacāro, asamādānacāro, gaṇabhojanaṃ, yāvadatthacīvaraṃ, yo ca tattha cīvaruppādo, so nesaṃ bhavissati.
pli-tv-kd7:1.3.5: atthatakaṭhinānaṃ vo, bhikkhave, imāni pañca kappissanti.”
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.4: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyya kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.8: saṅgho imaṃ kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno deti kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.9: yassāyasmato khamati imassa kaṭhinadussassa itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dānaṃ kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.11: “dinnaṃ idaṃ saṅghena kaṭhinadussaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno kaṭhinaṃ attharituṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.4.12: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.1: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ, evaṃ anatthataṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.21: na aññatra saṅghāṭiyā atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.22: na aññatra uttarāsaṅgena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.23: na aññatra antaravāsakena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.24: na aññatra pañcakena vā atirekapañcakena vā tadaheva sañchinnena samaṇḍalīkatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.25: na aññatra puggalassa atthārā atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.26: sammā ceva atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ, tañce nissīmaṭṭho anumodati, evampi anatthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.5.27: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, anatthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.6.1: [catuvīsati ākārā] kathañca bhikkhave, atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ?
pli-tv-kd7:1.6.2: ahatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. ahatakappena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. pilotikāya atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. paṃsukūlena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. pāpaṇikena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. animittakatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. aparikathākatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. akukkukatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. asannidhikatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. anissaggiyena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. kappakatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. saṅghāṭiyā atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. uttarāsaṅgena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. antaravāsakena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. pañcakena vā atirekapañcakena vā tadaheva sañchinnena samaṇḍalīkatena atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. puggalassa atthārā atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. sammā ce atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ. tañce sīmaṭṭho anumodati, evampi atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, atthataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ.
pli-tv-kd7:1.7.1: [sattarasa ākārā] kathañca bhikkhave, ubbhataṃ hoti kaṭhinaṃ?
pli-tv-kd7:1.7.3: pakkamanantikā niṭṭhānantikā sanniṭṭhānantikā nāsanantikā savaṇantikā āsāvacchedikā sīmātikkantikā sahubbhārā”ti.

pli-tv-kd7:2.2.7: so katacīvaro “paccessaṃ. paccessa”nti bahiddhā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ vītināmeti.

pli-tv-kd7:11.1.1: bhikkhu atthatakaṭhino disaṅgamiko pakkamati cīvarapaṭiviṃsaṃ apacinayamāno.
pli-tv-kd7:11.1.2: tamenaṃ disaṅgataṃ bhikkhū pucchanti: “kahaṃ tvaṃ āvuso vassaṃ vuttho? kattha ca te cīvarapaṭiviṃso”ti.

pli-tv-kd7:13.1.1: dve me bhikkhave, kaṭhinassa paḷibodhā, dve apaḷibodhā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.2: katame ca bhikkhave, dve kaṭhinassa paḷibodhā?
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vasati vā tasmiṃ āvāse, sāpekkho vā pakkamati “paccessa”nti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.8: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ akataṃ vā hoti vippakataṃ vā cīvarāsā vā anupacchinnā.
pli-tv-kd7:13.1.10: ime kho bhikkhave, dve kaṭhinassa paḷibodhā.

pli-tv-kd7:13.2.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu pakkamati tamhā āvāsā cattena vantena muttena anapekho “na paccessa”nti.
pli-tv-kd7:13.2.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
